notes.text: The sheet carries the author's dark 31 at upper left and a thin pale foliation 70 in another unnamed hand at lower left. The main text continues with a reference to conditions a), c), and raised d) on p. 28. Two later references repeat p. 28, and circled a also names a), b), c), 1°) and page 27.

The manuscript asks A-t-on aussi la condition b) and ends the displayed intersection condition with a question mark. It then gives an argument beginning Si on avait and ending absurde. The paragraph first writes the element labels x_i and x_j, with the first heavily retraced, and later writes x et y after a cancellation. Those local labels are retained as written; no identification or repair is supplied, and the argument has not been independently checked.

The opening intersection expression has a raised subset-Sigma_k addition attached before its baseline comma. The main paragraph also writes Sigma_<x est tot with a raised t ordonné. The abbreviation remains literal. The k forms in the formulas sometimes have joined h-like arms; the same sheet supplies an angular k in i,j<k. This is a report of local letter shapes, without a mathematical substitution.

Under Conséquence, the author calls the described déploiements équisinguliers de stratifications, indexés par I equivalent to the following structure. The first word after the heading has a capital-shaped L, and the state of dans later in that paragraph remains open. The marginal note reads si or et, then les comp. connexes des Sigma_i sont de dim finie, followed by three separate final marks. The note's introductory group remains unresolved.

Circled a describes an espace top. ordonné Sigma, recalls conditions on page 27, and adds a condition introduced through I-tilde=pi_0(Sigma). The source places d'immersion propre before a darker raised bordant and the map from Sigma_ij to Sigma_j; mono is underlined on the next left baseline. The label b_ij has no separate underline: the short lower bar belongs to j's foot. The shaft's point-like endpoint leaves its head contour open.

A detached dark point stands above the tilde of I in the i,j membership formula. Its position is recorded in a TeX source-position comment, an inventory entry and the whole-formula audit reading. The point has no assigned mathematical role. The live/struck state of aux is also left explicit, and no extra cancelled word is visible between condition and que.

Circled b gives Une application strictement croissante, followed by the written parenthesis pas néc. surjection and a headed map from I-tilde to I. The abbreviation néc. is resolved from its letters, accent and point; surjection retains its visible ending. These are statements of what the manuscript writes. No proof check or conditional theorem has been supplied by this reading.

A tiny isolated triangular dark point lies well below the final map shaft and both object baselines, near the lower crop edge (approximately 986,2337). Its provenance and role are unresolved. It is documented in the audit source-position comment without a textual glyph or a counted manuscript difference.

main_review:
Root viewed native whole071 once and read completeC,H,M0623–25. Author31 at head, otherhand70 below. The page opens satisfaisant les conditions a)c),d) de p.28; d) sits interlinear. A-t-on aussi rather than Montrons is visible; opening intersection equality ends in a question. Proof paragraph contains a crowded x_i/second glyph pair; do not use both witnesses to supply indices. Later x et y are literal. Conséquence heading is underlined; quotes, les/Les, indexés ending, dans strike state need crops. Left slanted marginal note begins et/si and concerns comp.connexes des Sigma_i/dimfinie. Circled a introduces an ordered topological space after a cancelledSigma; aux strike state and possible cancelled fragment before que need inspection. Bordant is darker/above the immersion wording; its attachment is separate from its letters. b_ij map label/head require crop. Circledb ends with shortened pas néc. and disputed surjection/surjective, then tildeI→I. All local disputes pending first crops; no mathematical proof check performed.
Root subsequently inspected all25 unique first crops p01 through p25. p01 d) is raised after c), with baseline comma and reference28; p02 A-t-on has a tall A, t and two hyphens. p03 whole equality/question and both k-like indices read literally; p04 raised subset Sigma_k attaches before the comma. p05 alors has a distinct l. p06 second x_j is supported by crossed x strokes and long connected j; first x_i remains retraced/doubtful. p07/p08 au dessus has no dash; p09 tot with raised t is visible. p10 the cancellation crosses On aurait, and x et y follows. p11 capital-shaped L in Les has a straight upright and broad right foot; opening quote consists of two strokes. p12 indexés has no separately isolated second e. p13 dans remains doubtful in strike state: the long stroke coincides with its joined baseline. p14 margin si|et remains open, si leading; comp. connexes des Sigma_i sont de dim finie... has three final marks and no dim stop. p15 crossed Sigma contour is recovered. p16 aux is live-leading with cancellation-state doubt. p17/p18 give no additional cancelled group before que; pour tout is crossed and partly obscured. p19 tildeI=pi0(Sigma), is literal. p20 the small detached dark point above tildeI has no assigned mathematical role; preserve source-position comment/inventory/audit. p21 d'immersion propre precedes the raised darker bordant, attached after propre; do not transpose the immersion phrase. p22 b_ij has its j foot but no extra underline, and the connector endpoint is a compact dark stub/point, arrow-leading with contour doubt. p23 strictement is fully written with reworked initial st. p24 pas néc. resolves M0625, with accented e/open c/distinct stop; following word is surjection. p25 final map has a visible right head. Root did not perform a mathematical proof check. Full proposed return/record remains to be reviewed before acceptance.

Root read every field of the complete 071 JSON and the entire TeX. Reused p25: the isolated tiny triangular point below the shaft has unresolved provenance and role, so it is recorded in a note and audit source-position context only, without a textual glyph or counted difference. All 31 audit boxes reviewed for coverage.
